title: "Methodology"
subtitle: "Sources, definitions and how the data is processed"

## Sources

| Source | What it provides | How it is accessed |
|---|---|---|
| EPİAŞ Şeffaflık Platformu | Prices, volumes, generation, consumption, imbalance | Web services, through the open source Python package [eptr2](https://github.com/Tideseed/eptr2) |
| EPDK | Licence registers | Published files |
| ENTSO-E Transparency Platform | Neighbouring markets (planned) | API |
| Resmî Gazete reproductions, Ministry and EPİAŞ pages, law-firm notes | Regulation timeline | Read by hand; see [method and sources](regulation/method.qmd) |

TR Power Lab is independent. It is not affiliated with EPİAŞ, TEİAŞ or EPDK. Figures come from these sources. Any errors in processing are mine.

## Conventions

- **Time:** all timestamps are in Türkiye time (UTC+3). Each hour is labelled by its start, so 14:00 covers 14:00 to 15:00.
- **Currency:** prices are in TRY per MWh, as published. Comparisons across years or countries also use the EUR and USD prices published by EPİAŞ, because TRY inflation distorts long TRY series.
- **Averages:** every average states whether it is simple (each hour weighted equally) or volume weighted.

## Definitions

- **PTF (Piyasa Takas Fiyatı):** the day ahead market clearing price.
- **SMF (Sistem Marjinal Fiyatı):** the system marginal price from the balancing market.
- **AOF (Ağırlıklı Ortalama Fiyat):** the volume weighted average price in the intraday market.

More definitions will be added as the reports grow.
